translation.title: Chlorhexidine Gluconate Topical Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is an antibacterial skin cleanser used for cleansing normal skin and wound areas, surgical hand disinfection, personal hand disinfection, and preoperative skin disinfection of the surgical site.
translation.usage: For cleansing normal skin and wounds: wipe the area with water, apply only the minimum amount needed to the skin or wound, wipe gently, then rinse thoroughly with water. For surgical hand disinfection: wet the hands and forearms with water, apply 5 mL of this product from the hands up to the elbows and scrub for about 3 minutes with a brush or sponge; rinse thoroughly under running water, repeat the process once more, then dry completely. For personal hand disinfection: wet the hands with water, apply 5 mL of this product and rub both hands vigorously for 15 seconds; rinse with water and dry completely. For preoperative skin disinfection: apply a sufficient amount to the surgical site and scrub for at least 2 minutes; dry with a sterile towel, repeat the process once more, then dry with a sterile towel.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are hypersensitive to other medicines, if you have, have had, or have a family history of an allergic condition such as asthma, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. For external use only - do not take it by mouth or inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care that it does not get into the eyes; if it does, rinse immediately and thoroughly with clean water. This medicine adsorbs to fibers and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon, etc.), so when using solution-soaked materials, supply fresh solution if the concentration falls below the effective level. It forms poorly soluble salts with anions in saline and similar solutions, so use clean distilled water for dilution. Replace diluted solutions used for hand cleansing with fresh solution at least daily. Organic substances such as serum and pus, and soaps, weaken the germicidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. Adverse reactions may occur - rarely shock (nausea, discomfort, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), and sometimes hypersensitivity such as rash and hives; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitization may occur. Store at room temperature.
